Green band: pointwise 10th–90th percentiles · solid: portfolio median · dashed: benchmark median

The median curve combines separate monthly quantiles; it is not one realizable path. The band is not an 80% guarantee for an entire path.

Downside and comparison

Drawdowns use monthly observations and include the starting value. Costs apply to scheduled trades; no opening or terminal liquidation costs are assumed.

Forecast mix

Research prototype · Stocks use a factor exposure model with zero stock-specific alpha. Simulations include historical shocks and changing volatility, but do not establish predictive skill or cover every possible crisis. Full-precision paths and assumptions are saved alongside this report.
